entities.name: Valla
entities.description: A plane that was originally a realm in Kaldheim, split off after a mighty weapon cracked the realm; it still contains an Immersturm region.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane whose realm Valla originally was.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: A realm of Kaldheim named for a raging storm of magic and populated by demons.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The tree from which part of the old Valla realm fell.

events.summary: A faction deploys a mighty weapon that cracks the old Valla realm in two; part falls from the World Tree and becomes the plane Valla.
events.quote: One of the combatant factions deployed a mighty weapon, which cracked the realm in twain.

events.summary: The remnant still attached to the World Tree is consumed by its Immersturm region and comes to be called Immersturm.
events.quote: the realm came to be called Immersturm

relations.note: originally a realm of Kaldheim before it split into a separate plane
relations.quote: Valla was originally a realm of Kaldheim
